description: The plot titled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset” illustrates how three evaluation metrics (Precision, Recall, and F1-score) vary across different model variants. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” on a categorical (non-numeric) scale with five categories: “Full model (Ours),” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly from 56 to 66, with evenly spaced tick marks at 2-point intervals (56, 58, 60, 62, 64, 66). The Precision line is purple with circular markers and a solid style, showing values of 65.45 (Full model), 61.06 (w/o Prompt), 62.22 (w/o Augmentation), 64.06 (w/o Attention), and 65.44 (w/o Prompt & Augmentation). The Recall line is blue with circular markers and a solid style, with values of 65.78 (Full model), 59.64 (w/o Prompt), 63.72 (w/o Augmentation), 59.17 (w/o Attention), and 56.82 (w/o Prompt & Augmentation). The F1-score line is tan/brown with circular markers and a solid style, with values of 65.56 (Full model), 60.16 (w/o Prompt), 62.63 (w/o Augmentation), 59.67 (w/o Attention), and 57.74 (w/o Prompt & Augmentation).
